hearing_workflow.title: Hearing in Hostess7
hearing_workflow.body: Hearing = listen (STT) + understand (Wernicke) + speak (Broca/TTS). hostess7_voice.py: arecord + whisper listen; spd-say/edge-tts speak. CMUdict phonetics in english brain. HOSTESS7_VOICE=1 HOSTESS7_LISTEN=1.

hearing_workflow.title: Listen → think → speak pipeline
hearing_workflow.body: Mic/text → whisper STT → Language Expert reply → TTS → optional lip-sync Graphics. Web: /api/listen /api/speak /api/ask. Hearing corpus + H7 library for acoustics/psych.

hearing_workflow.title: Lossless audio-adjacent storage
hearing_workflow.body: Brain JSON FLD1, books H7B, Field WRDT1 — all lossless round-trip. Phonetic lexicon and textbook text preserve every character on pack/unpack.

hearing_workflow.title: GAC1 / ZOCRAM1 sovereign audio
hearing_workflow.body: Final_Ear GAC1 inside ZOCRAM1 (.zocr) — predictive frames, sealed segments, sovereign time. Better than naked PCM: provenance weave, cochlear-safe profiles, Shannon entropy per segment. Queen POST /api/queen-earball action gac1|pack_audio|verify_audio. Hostess7 bridge: field_final_ear_bridge.py listen → eye_ear_fusion.

hearing_workflow.title: Secure neural path — Eye↔Ear
hearing_workflow.body: Sovereign time seals every tick; eye↔ear sync never desync (SQUIDGIE on drift). Signal intel: encoded carriers, mixed interference, deceit composite. Queen /api/sense-neural analyze + /api/queen-earball secure_identify. HOSTESS7_FINAL_EAR=1 routes listen_once through secure identify.
